items.title: Delta CEO says FAA ground stop will cost “tens of millions of dollars”
items.summary:
Delta CEO Ed Bastian says Friday’s nationwide FAA ground stop will cost “tens of millions of dollars.”

On Fortune Daily with Ellie Austin, Bastian explained what went wrong and what needs to change before the holiday travel rush.

items.title: SpaceX just caught a spaceship out of the sky
items.summary: SpaceX's Ship 42 circled the Earth 14 times, then came back 22.5 hours later and was caught mid-air by the same tower it launched from, the first catch of a spaceship returning from orbit. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen walks through the flight and why it matters for Starlink, AI satellites and SpaceX's compute business.

items.title: Musk Calls Starlink a “Gamechanger” as Lufthansa Plans to Equip Around 850 Aircraft
items.summary: Key TakeawaysLufthansa’s first long-haul Starlink jet flies Munich to Tokyo on Dec. 3, part of a plan to equip around 850 aircraft by 2029.

items.title: Delta CEO: Most airlines touting Starlink “haven’t even started yet”
items.summary:
“This is about the total experience, and customers are not choosing airlines based on the Wi-Fi.”

At the F500 Innovation Forum, Delta CEO Ed Bastian told Alyson Shontell that the airline helped Elon Musk’s satellite Wi-Fi “get started in aviation,” but the two sides “just couldn’t come to agreement on a business model.”

items.title: United Airlines Resolves Another Outage. The Stock Is Falling.
items.summary: The carrier said it was working to get things back up and running.

items.title: Berkshire trims Bank of America, Capital One stakes, adds to Delta investment
items.summary: Investment.com -- Berkshire Hathaway reshuffled its equity portfolio in the third quarter, cutting its exposure to Bank of America and Capital One while increasing its investment in Delta Air Lines and building a new position in Italian technology company Bending Spoons, a regulatory filing showed on Monday.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Lennar, Starts Bending Spoons, Trims Bank Of America In Q3
items.summary: According to the company’s filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission on Monday, the firm’s overall equity portfolio stood at roughly $304 billion across about 30 positions as of the end of the quarter.

items.title: Here's What Berkshire Hathaway Bought and Sold in Q3
items.summary: Berkshire mostly continued where it left off in Q2. Here are all the stocks that Greg Abel & Co. added to the portfolio — and the ones they sold, too.
